notes: οὐδέποτε takes the discontinuous nothing … ever as one unit; the temporal element is no part of what nothing alone carries (rule 41's closing clause). Heading the unit on ever, the word glossing the ποτε element, remains defensible under rule 66's compound test.
εἰσῆλθεν keeps only its verb word, the expressed εἰς carrying the single English preposition written for preverb and preposition together (rule 106).
